normalized_requirement: Employee can create, edit and soft-delete own AI tasks and access public product sections.
Employee can view Personal Dashboard, ratings and company analytics and manage own privacy/vacation.
Director has read access to employees/tasks in own directorate and can export own directorate.
Director must not access technical scoring trace or change scoring.
Executive/CEO can view whole-company analytics and drill down company → directorate → employee → task.
Executive/CEO does not manage system settings.
Admin has company-wide system-management scope for org structure, roles, calendar, taxonomy, tools, profiles, technical scoring trace, audit logs and export.
Admin cannot manually change task Complexity or Score.
Peers never see another employee's raw input, clarification log or task links regardless of peer privacy level.
Director may access raw input, clarifications, links and normalized task data only inside own directorate.
Executive and Admin may access raw task data according to whole-company authorized scope.
Technical scoring trace is Admin-only.
Corporate export is unavailable to Employee, directorate-scoped for Director, company-scoped for Executive/Admin.
Privacy/access rules must be enforced by backend authorization for each object request/export, not only by UI hiding.
There is no employee self-registration flow.
MVP login verifies personnel number + phone against the corporate personnel source, without SMS/password in Product v1.0.
On successful personnel verification, employee name and directorate are populated from personnel data.
Application role/status is controlled by the application and assigned only by Admin.
First successful login requires onboarding in 4–5 screens/steps.
When Monthly Goal setup is required, it gates entry to the main interface.
Personnel-number + phone is explicitly recognized by Product v1.0 as weaker than production-grade SSO/2FA.
Individual public leaderboard is based on Annual Score for the current calendar year.
Annual Score/current leaderboard reset January 1; pet, HP, Evolution XP, history, achievements and cosmetics persist.
Past-year top employees may retain visual status badges/cosmetics without gameplay advantage.
Mandatory public employee fields include rank, name, Annual Score, pet appearance and prior-year status rewards.
Directorate ranking uses Average Directorate Score based on annual directorate task/goal points and authorized employee denominator as defined by Product semantics.
Directorate card exposes rank, Average Score, Total Score and authorized employee count.
Directorate card includes internal employee leaderboard; profile detail respects peer privacy level.
Each task/version preserves directorate_id_at_task_time; pre-transfer points remain attributed historically.
Terminated employees leave current individual ranking/current denominator while historical analytics remain.
Admin can hide terminated/inactive profiles without deleting history.
Peer privacy levels are Closed, Standard (default) and Open.
Closed exposes only mandatory public fields.
Standard adds approved aggregates such as task count, complexity distribution, streak, goals, achievements and AI tools.
Open additionally exposes normalized AI-case description, tool(s), Complexity and score.
Raw input, clarification log and task links are never exposed to peers, including Open privacy.
Employee may change privacy at any time; the change applies immediately.
Peer privacy does not restrict authorized Director/Executive/Admin scope.
Personnel identity, current directorate, application role/status and active state are represented separately from immutable task history.
Task/version data preserves raw input, normalized description, processing/classification output, timestamps and version lineage needed for audit.
Task-tool mapping supports recognized/unrecognized tools, primary flag, role description and sequence when known.
Task URLs are stored independently and can be removed without the application opening/analyzing them.
Score accounting uses event/ledger semantics with deltas, source references, directorate attribution, SPB event date and reversal linkage.
Pet state covers HP, health state, vacation, current/best streak, Evolution XP/stage/branch and coma recovery progress.
Daily activity preserves working-day/vacation context, task count and maximum Complexity needed to reproduce HP/streak.
Task edit/delete/recalculation must remain reproducible through versioning and ledger/reversal semantics rather than destructive overwrite.
End-of-day jobs must be idempotent and support safe recalculation after edit/delete.
Goal rule_json must be declarative/backend-executable; free-form LLM judgment alone cannot decide goal completion.
Corporate Personnel integration is required, but protocol/base URL/auth/unique employee key/normalization/sync details are not supplied and must not be invented.
LLM and STT are provider dependencies; current source set does not freeze production vendor endpoint/credentials/model.
Application is online-first/online-only for data mutation and must handle network failure explicitly.
Role/object authorization, privacy and auditability are backend-enforced invariants.
No real production credentials/secrets are defined by the source set.
